milestones.title: M0 - Standalone foundation
milestones.description: Independent official Terrain Diffusion baseline, placeholder blocks, reproducible build and CI. Runtime certification is tracked separately.

milestones.title: M1 - Minimal-install acceptance
milestones.description: User-led acceptance with only Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge, official Terrain Diffusion and this addon. Record actual runtime evidence.

milestones.title: M2 - Geology controls and diagnostics
milestones.description: World-persistent settings, generation versioning, diagnostics and terrain-aware regional refinements.

milestones.title: M3 - Assets and masonry
milestones.description: Deferred visual assets and practical building pieces, with stable IDs and recorded provenance.

milestones.title: M4 - City palette API
milestones.description: Independent regional identity API that external city systems can adopt without adding a mandatory city-mod dependency.

milestones.title: M5 - Optional integrations
milestones.description: Later Ulti-World adapter and explicit compatibility expansion after standalone acceptance.
